name: tapia
description: An Electron application with React and TypeScript
author: soma.camer.digital

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:node && pnpm run typecheck:web
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @soma/ui run build && electron-vite build
scripts.build:mac: pnpm --filter @soma/ui run build && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:mac:dev: pnpm --filter @soma/ui run build && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.dev.yml
scripts.build:mac:staging: pnpm --filter @soma/ui run build && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.staging.yml
scripts.build:linux: pnpm --filter @soma/ui run build && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.build:linux:dev: pnpm --filter @soma/ui run build && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.dev.yml
scripts.build:linux:staging: pnpm --filter @soma/ui run build && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.staging.yml
